overall_prep_notes: Total prep time across all 13 assets is approximately 2.5 hours. The bulk is M3 0-200 Number Line (11 letter pages tiled), M4 Decomposition Cards (30 cards laminated), M5 Compare Cards (24 cards), and M9 Third/Sixth Pizza Cards. Base-ten blocks (M1) and snap cubes (M6) are standard math-kit items. The three character puppets (Hugo, Tina, Ona) should be printed on cardstock for years of reuse.

assets.name: Base-Ten Blocks
assets.purpose: Per-pair set: 4 hundred-flats + 20 ten-rods + 30 unit-cubes. Used for Lesson 1 representation and Lesson 2 composition.
assets.page_layout: Not printable — physical blocks from the classroom math kit. Page is a storage-bag label.

image_placeholders.description: A storage-bag label, ~3in × 4in, in B&W line-art. Shows a hundred-flat, a ten-rod, and a unit-cube stacked, with the header 'BASE-TEN BLOCKS — 4 flats + 20 tens + 30 ones per pair'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M1_BASE_TEN_LABEL: keywords (base-ten, blocks) name what the label shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Prep this step carefully. Confirm you have a class set of base-ten blocks (4 flats + 20 tens + 30 ones per pair = ~40 flats + 200 tens + 300 ones for a class of 20).
Print storage labels; tape to zip-top bags.
Sort into per-pair bags before Lesson 1.
Have bags ready at the start of Lessons 1 and 2.
Optional: use printable base-ten cards if physical blocks are unavailable.
assets.quantity_per_class: 4 flats + 20 tens + 30 ones per pair = ~40+200+300 for a class of 20.

assets.name: Place-Value Mat
assets.purpose: Letter-size mat with three labeled columns: HUNDREDS, TENS, ONES. Used in Lessons 1 and 2 for organising base-ten representations.
assets.page_layout: Single letter page, landscape. Three labeled columns; thin borders between.

image_placeholders.description: A place-value mat in B&W line-art on a landscape letter page. Three columns from left to right: HUNDREDS (with a hundred-flat icon), TENS (with a ten-rod icon), ONES (with a unit-cube icon). Each column ~3.5in wide and 7in tall. Thin black borders between columns.
image_placeholders.placement: Centred on the page, full-width landscape.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M2_PLACE_VALUE_MAT: keywords (mat, columns) name what the page shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 mat per child (20+ pages for a class of 20).
Laminate every page.
Hand out at the start of Lesson 1; collect at the end of Lesson 2.
Store mats in a labelled folder between lessons.
Optional: print extras for emerging-learner small group review.
assets.quantity_per_class: 1 mat per child = 20+ for a class of 20.

assets.name: 0-200 Number Line
assets.purpose: Long printable strip showing numbers 0 to 200 with cells ~2.5in each. Used in Lesson 1 skip-counting and Lesson 2 ordering.
assets.page_layout: 11 letter pages, landscape. Each page holds 20 cells of the Number Line; 11 pages tile to 220 cells (0 to 200 plus margin).

image_placeholders.description: A 20-cell horizontal Number Line tile in B&W line-art on a landscape letter page. Each cell ~1.3in wide × 1.2in tall with the numeral printed in the centre. Cells border each other with thin cut-lines so multiple pages tile seamlessly.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M3_NUMBER_LINE_PAGE: keywords (number-line, cells) name what the page shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print all 11 pages on cardstock if available; otherwise paper + laminate.
Laminate each page before assembly.
Prep this step carefully. Tape pages together (or use removable painter's tape) to make a continuous strip ~25ft long.
Lay the strip on the carpet for Lessons 1 and 2; roll up after each lesson.
Optional: use a long roll of paper instead of tiled letter pages.

assets.name: Number Decomposition Cards
assets.purpose: Set of 30 cards. Each shows a target number (47, 89, 132, 178, etc.) and three blank slots for the child to write three different decompositions.
assets.page_layout: 5 letter pages, portrait. Each page holds 6 decomposition cards in a 2x3 grid.

image_placeholders.description: A decomposition card in B&W line-art, ~3in × 4in. Top half shows the target number in a large circle (e.g., 132) with the label 'TARGET'. Bottom half has three blank decomposition lines '___+___+___'. Cut lines around each card.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M4_DECOMP_CARD: keywords (decomposition, card) name what the card shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 5 pages on cardstock.
Laminate every page before cutting.
Cut along cut lines into 30 individual cards.
Sort by difficulty (under 100, 100-150, 150-200). Colour-code the corner with a sticker if desired.
Distribute 10 cards per pair for Lesson 2 Station A.

assets.name: Compare-Two-Numbers Cards
assets.purpose: Set of 24 number-pair cards. Used in Lesson 2 partner game for compare-and-explain practice.
assets.page_layout: 4 letter pages, portrait. Each page holds 6 compare cards in a 2x3 grid.

image_placeholders.description: A compare card in B&W line-art, ~3in × 4in. Two number boxes side by side (e.g., '147' and '174') with a '?' bubble between them. Below: 'Which is bigger? Why?'. Cut lines around each card.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M5_COMPARE_CARD: keywords (compare, card) name what the card shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 4 pages on cardstock.
Laminate every page before cutting.
Cut along cut lines into 24 individual cards.
Sort by type (same-hundreds pairs, different-hundreds pairs, edge cases like 99 vs 100).
Distribute 8 cards per pair for Lesson 2 Station B.

assets.name: Pair-Up Cubes
assets.purpose: Per-pair set of 30 connecting cubes. Used in Lesson 3 even/odd investigation — children try to pair up the cubes.
assets.page_layout: Not printable — physical snap cubes from the classroom math kit. Page is a storage-bag label.

image_placeholders.description: A storage-bag label, ~3in × 4in, in B&W line-art. Shows two connected cubes with a header 'PAIR-UP CUBES — 30 per pair'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M6_CUBES_LABEL: keywords (cubes, pair-up) name what the label shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Confirm you have a class set of snap cubes (30 per pair = 300 for a class of 20).
Print storage labels; tape to zip-top bags.
Sort into per-pair bags before Lesson 3.
Have bags ready at the start of Lesson 3.
Optional: use any small countable items (e.g., LEGO bricks) if snap cubes are unavailable.
assets.quantity_per_class: 30 cubes per pair = 300 for a class of 20.

assets.name: Hundreds Chart 1-100
assets.purpose: Letter-size hundreds chart in a 10x10 grid. Used in Lesson 3 even/odd sort and Lesson 1 skip-counting reference.

image_placeholders.description: A 10x10 hundreds chart in B&W line-art on a portrait letter page. Numbers 1-100 in a 10-row × 10-column grid. Each cell ~0.7in × 0.7in with the numeral centred. Thin black borders.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M7_HUNDREDS_CHART: keywords (hundreds, chart) name what the page shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 chart per pair (10+ pages for a class of 20).
Laminate every page so children can use dry-erase markers.
Hand out at the start of Lesson 3.
Store in a labelled folder.
Optional: have a large classroom poster version for whole-class demos.
assets.quantity_per_class: 1 chart per pair = 10+ for a class of 20.

assets.name: Estimation Jars
assets.purpose: Three clear jars of different sizes for Lesson 4 estimation: small (~50 items), medium (~100 items), large (~175 items). Items can be buttons, marbles, beans, or cubes.
assets.page_layout: Not printable — physical jars. Page is a label/instructions sheet.

image_placeholders.description: A label and instructions sheet, ~7in × 9in, in B&W line-art. Shows three jar illustrations (small, medium, large) with capacity labels '~50, ~100, ~175'. Below the illustrations, a list of suitable items.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M8_JARS_LABEL: keywords (jars, estimation) name what the page shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Source 3 clear glass or plastic jars (small ~250mL, medium ~500mL, large ~1L).
Fill jar 1 with ~45-55 small items (buttons, marbles, beans).
Fill jar 2 with ~95-105 items.
Fill jar 3 with ~165-180 items.
Print the labels sheet and tape to a wall as a station reference.

assets.name: Third/Sixth Pizza Cards
assets.purpose: Printable letter-size cards showing whole pizzas, thirds, and sixths. Used in Lesson 5 to reveal that 1/3 = 2/6 visually.
assets.page_layout: 3 letter pages, portrait. Each page holds 2 pizza cards (whole, thirds, sixths) plus blank pizza outline cards for shading practice.

image_placeholders.description: Pizza fraction cards in B&W line-art, ~5in diameter each. Card 1: whole pizza (no divisions). Card 2: divided into 3 equal thirds. Card 3: divided into 6 equal sixths. Card 4: blank pizza outline for shading practice. Each card has a thin black border.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M9_PIZZA_CARD: keywords (pizza, thirds, sixths) name what the cards show.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 3 pages on cardstock.
Laminate every page before cutting.
Cut into individual pizza cards.
Sort: whole, thirds, sixths, blanks.
Distribute one set per group of 4 children for Lesson 5.
assets.quantity_per_class: 1 set per group = ~5 sets for a class of 20.

assets.name: Sharing Paper Plates
assets.purpose: Set of 6 paper plates per group. Children deal collections fairly between 2, 3, 4, or 6 sharers in Lesson 5.
assets.page_layout: Not printable — real disposable paper plates.

image_placeholders.description: A storage-bag label, ~3in × 4in, in B&W line-art. Shows a stack of 4 paper plates with a header 'SHARING PLATES — 6 per group'. Decorative cookie icons around the border.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M10_PLATES_LABEL: keywords (plates, share) name what the label shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Prep this step carefully. Buy a pack of small disposable paper plates (6 per group = ~30 for a class of 20 in groups of 4).
Print storage labels; tape to plate stacks if desired.
Sort into per-group sets before Lesson 5.
Have plates ready at the start of Lesson 5.
Reuse plates across the week if they stay clean.
assets.quantity_per_class: 6 plates per group = ~30 for a class of 20.
